notes: Vaulty learns to research: when the guide doesn't know, it now looks the answer up live (game data, then the Warframe Wiki, then Wikipedia) with a staged progress bar and a Stop button, and cites its source. The on-device AI, once downloaded, is detected on your device and loads straight from it after every update — no more re-download prompts; the status line now says 'AI ready on this device'. Vaulty also remembers — on this device only — the gear and topics you ask about, for a welcome-back greeting and a 'My usual' chip; see or clear it via 'What Vaulty remembers'. Nothing is uploaded. First training pass: guide coverage added for Aya, best auras, starter frames, Necramechs, Incarnon, Archwing and clans, and a fuzzy-match bug that answered an Aya question with fish drop tables is fixed.
